sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中度过七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最棒的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝175周年，陪伴您理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受 nytimes.com 上的斜杠 subscribe 特惠。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Today we have something really special for you.
sentences.zh: 今天我们为你准备了一些特别的东西。

sentences.en: A blissful break from the news.
sentences.zh: 一段远离新闻的安宁休憩时光。

sentences.en: It's a new series from NYT Audio called Animal.
sentences.zh: 这是《纽约时报》音频部推出的全新系列，名为《动物》。

sentences.en: My colleague Sam Anderson from The Times Magazine traveled the world to have encounters with animals.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、来自《时报杂志》的萨姆·安德森环游世界去与动物相遇。

sentences.en: Not to claim them or to tame them, but just to appreciate them.
sentences.zh: 不是为了占有它们，也不是为了驯服它们，而只是为了欣赏它们。

sentences.en: Each episode is a journey to get closer to a creature that Sam loves.
sentences.zh: 每一集都是一次旅程，旨在走近萨姆所热爱的一种生物。

sentences.en: For the next six weeks, we'll be running this limited series every Sunday here on the Daily Feed.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六周里，我们将在每周日的“每日之声”栏目播出这个限定系列。

sentences.en: But if you want to hear all the episodes right now, you can search for it wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想立刻收听所有节目，可以在你获取播客的任何地方搜索它。

sentences.en: Today, episode three.
sentences.zh: 今天播出第三集。

sentences.en: Hope you enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 希望你喜欢。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is Animal.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《动物》。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·安德森。

sentences.en: Episode three.
sentences.zh: 第三集。

sentences.en: Manatees.
sentences.zh: 海牛。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: How about yourself?
sentences.zh: 你自己呢？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: You picked a great day.
sentences.zh: 你挑了个好日子。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 来吧。

sentences.en: What are the rules on that?
sentences.zh: 那个有什么规定吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, the rain's not an issue.
sentences.zh: 对，下雨不是问题。

sentences.en: It's the lightning.
sentences.zh: 是闪电。

sentences.en: And I got an app on my phone here that's, yeah, we definitely have some lightning.
sentences.zh: 我手机上装了个应用，对，我们确实有雷电。

sentences.en: But it's their call, obviously.
sentences.zh: 但显然这由他们决定。

sentences.en: But I'm not comfortable going out if there's a lot of lightning.
sentences.zh: 不过如果有大量闪电，我可不想出去。

sentences.en: You don't want to be on the water during the lightning.
sentences.zh: 你可不想在打雷的时候待在水上。

sentences.en: But so you all booked a private tour?
sentences.zh: 所以你们都预订了私人游览？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Kelsey.
sentences.zh: 凯尔西。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think Kelsey's going to join us.
sentences.zh: 对，我想凯尔西会加入我们。

sentences.en: He just texted me.
sentences.zh: 他刚给我发了短信。

sentences.en: For some reason I do not fully understand, I've always wanted to get in the water with a manatee.
sentences.zh: 出于某种我不太明白的原因，我一直想和海牛一起下水。

sentences.en: A manatee is a big, pudgy, blubby-looking, I don't know, cross between a walrus and a potato.
sentences.zh: 海牛是个大块头、圆滚滚、胖乎乎的，怎么说呢，像是海象和土豆的结合体。

sentences.en: Sometimes people call them sea cows because they basically just float around grazing.
sentences.zh: 有时人们叫它们海牛，因为它们基本上就是到处漂浮着吃草。

sentences.en: But they're a lot weirder looking than cows.
sentences.zh: 但它们看起来比牛怪异得多。

sentences.en: They have these funny little flippers, sort of boomerang-shaped flippers up front that they use to navigate around.
sentences.zh: 它们长着滑稽的小鳍，前端有点像回旋镖形状的鳍，用来到处游动。

sentences.en: And then this big, flat paddle of a tail, like a super beaver or something.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一条扁平的大尾巴，像超级海狸什么的。

sentences.en: They eat wet vegetables, seagrass mainly, almost never aggressive.
sentences.zh: 它们吃湿漉漉的植物，主要是海草，几乎从不具攻击性。

sentences.en: They kind of float outside all of these cycles of predators and prey and doing stuff.
sentences.zh: 它们仿佛漂浮在所有捕食者与猎物以及世俗循环之外。

sentences.en: They just float there.
sentences.zh: 它们就那样漂浮着。

sentences.en: And I sort of want to float outside all of those cycles and just not worry about deadlines and meetings and whatever.
sentences.zh: 而我也有些想漂浮在所有这些循环之外，不去担心死线、会议以及各种乱七八糟的事。

sentences.en: It's stressful out there.
sentences.zh: 外面的世界压力好大。

sentences.en: But not under the water.
sentences.zh: 但在水下却没有。

sentences.en: Looks like they're sending people out.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们准备放人下去了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They'll be watching the weather.
sentences.zh: 他们会留意天气的。

sentences.en: So, when I think about getting in the water with a manatee, I don't know exactly what I want to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我想象和海牛一起下水时，我并不确切知道我希望发生什么。

sentences.en: But when I really try to imagine it, I think what I want is for a manatee to look at me.
sentences.zh: 但当我真正试着去想象时，我想我希望的是有一头海牛看着我。

sentences.en: I want to see a manatee seeing me.
sentences.zh: 我想看到一头海牛在看着我。

sentences.en: I want to look at a manatee and I want the manatee to look back at me.
sentences.zh: 我想看着海牛，而海牛也能回看我。

sentences.en: And I just want to have a moment of connection or whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 我只想有那么一个心领神会或是诸如此类的时刻。

sentences.en: People said they were ugly.
sentences.zh: 人们说它们长得很丑。

sentences.en: Now, manatees are a protected species.
sentences.zh: 现在，海牛是受保护物种。

sentences.en: And the only place I know of in the United States where you can legally swim with manatees is a place in Florida called Crystal River.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，在美国唯一能合法与海牛共游的地方是佛罗里达州一个叫水晶河的地方。

sentences.en: I'd heard about that place from watching the classic manatee documentary made by Jacques Cousteau back in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 我从雅克·库斯托在20世纪70年代制作的经典海牛纪录片中听说过那个地方。

sentences.en: And Jacques Cousteau and his whole crew of French oceanographers with their little red beanies, they have a local guide.
sentences.zh: 雅克·库斯托和他那群戴着小红帽的法国海洋学家团队，他们有一位当地向导。

sentences.en: And it's a kid, a teenager named Buddy Powell.
sentences.zh: 那是个孩子，一个名叫巴迪·鲍尔的青少年。

sentences.en: This is you in your element.
sentences.zh: 这就是如鱼得水的你。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is my element.
sentences.zh: 对，这就是我的主场。

sentences.en: And Buddy Powell is actually still there.
sentences.zh: 而巴迪·鲍尔其实至今还在那里。

sentences.en: In the decades since, he's become maybe the preeminent manatee scientist in the world.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，他成为了世界上首屈一指的海牛科学家。

sentences.en: And he's the director of a big marine center not far from Crystal River.
sentences.zh: 他还是水晶河附近一家大型海洋中心的主任。

sentences.en: And he occasionally will still take people around Crystal River where he grew up, as he did for Jacques Cousteau.
sentences.zh: 他偶尔仍会带人们参观他长大的水晶河，就像当年为雅克·库斯托做的那样。

sentences.en: What is this?
sentences.zh: 这是什么？

sentences.en: This is liability assumption of risk?
sentences.zh: 这是责任豁免书吗？

sentences.en: So we arranged a private boat tour with Buddy Powell.
sentences.zh: 于是我们安排了一次由巴迪·鲍尔带队的私人船游。

sentences.en: Me and my colleague Caitlin Roberts, who is there with the microphone.
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事凯特琳·罗伯茨，她带着麦克风在那里。

sentences.en: Buddy's PR person, Kelsey, is going to join us, too.
sentences.zh: 巴迪的公关凯尔西也会加入我们。

sentences.en: She's running a little late.
sentences.zh: 她稍微有点迟到。

sentences.en: Okay, not here yet.
sentences.zh: 好吧，还没到。

sentences.en: No, she's close, though.
sentences.zh: 对，不过她快到了。

sentences.en: All right, guys, well, we're going to go ahead and get started.
sentences.zh: 好了，伙计们，我们要准备开始了。

sentences.en: So Caitlin and I had actually been in Florida for about a week before this swimming day.
sentences.zh: 所以凯特琳和我其实在这次下水日之前就已经在佛罗里达呆了大约一周。

sentences.en: I'm crisscrossing the state, talking to various manatee experts, kind of getting ready for that moment when I get in the water and have an encounter.
sentences.zh: 我穿梭于全州，采访各种海牛专家，为我下水并与它们相遇的那一刻做准备。

sentences.en: Everyone here is for 10-15, correct?
sentences.zh: 这里所有人都是10到15岁，对吗？

sentences.en: And once you start, as soon as you start learning about manatees, things get pretty heavy.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始，只要你开始了解海牛，事情就会变得相当沉重。

sentences.en: Because from a distance, manatees make me very happy, and I find them very soothing.
sentences.zh: 因为从远处看，海牛让我非常开心，我也觉得它们非常疗愈。

sentences.en: Manatees, I don't think, experience life that way, which we found out very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我想海牛体验生活的方式并非如此，我们很快就发现了这一点。

sentences.en: We talked to a guy who works with the Save the Manatee Club, and he paddles around in his canoe, and he recognizes all the manatees by their scars,
sentences.zh: 我们和一位在“拯救海牛俱乐部”工作的人聊了聊，他划着独木舟四处游荡，通过伤疤认出所有的海牛，

sentences.en: by the damage that they've taken.
sentences.zh: 通过它们受过的伤。

sentences.en: And so, manatees are, they're huge animals, they float slowly and often right near the surface, and so when a speedboat comes ripping through, often it will hit a manatee.
sentences.zh: 所以，海牛是庞大的动物，它们缓慢漂浮，而且常常就在水面附近，因此当快艇呼啸而过时，经常会撞到海牛。

sentences.en: And getting hit by a speedboat is basically like getting hit by a truck that has swords all over it.
sentences.zh: 而被快艇撞击基本上就像被一辆插满剑的卡车撞到一样。

sentences.en: So, he's seen manatees sliced up so badly, they don't have tails, or hit so hard by a boat that their ribs are sticking out.
sentences.zh: 所以，他见过被切得面目全非、连尾巴都没有的海牛，或者被船撞得肋骨都戳出来的海牛。

sentences.en: Just the worst of the worSt.
sentences.zh: 简直是惨绝人寰。

sentences.en: He also told us some really freaky stories about alligators that I'm not going to get into right now, but...
sentences.zh: 他还给我们讲了一些关于短吻鳄的诡异故事，我现在就不展开讲了，但是……

sentences.en: You'll need to get wetsuits and snorkeling gear here.
sentences.zh: 你得在这里买潜水衣和浮潜装备。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, just rent it.
sentences.zh: 那就租一套吧。

sentences.en: And then you'll need to watch a video.
sentences.zh: 然后你需要看一段视频。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Manatee Manatee Manatee Manatee Manatee Manatee.
sentences.zh: 海牛海牛海牛海牛海牛海牛。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, where else did we go?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们还去了哪里？

sentences.en: We went to this pathology lab in Tampa, where they actually do autopsies on every manatee that turns up dead in Florida, to figure out the reasons why.
sentences.zh: 我们去了坦帕的这家病理实验室，他们在那里对在佛罗里达被发现死亡的每一头海牛进行尸检，以查明原因。

sentences.en: And they've been seeing a huge increase in the number of manatees.
sentences.zh: 他们发现海牛的死亡数量大幅增加。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's just days on end, you know, eight, nine, ten manatees.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至连续好几天，你知道的，八头、九头、十头海牛。

sentences.en: And when they open up the door the next day, it's just that many manatees again, and it's just kind of nonstop.
sentences.zh: 而第二天他们打开门时，又是那么多海牛，简直没完没了。

sentences.en: The boat strikes, there's something called red tide, which is a kind of algae that blooms in the water under certain conditions, and it makes manatees drown.
sentences.zh: 船只碰撞，还有一种叫红潮的东西，那是一种在特定条件下在水中大量繁殖的藻类，会导致海牛窒息。

sentences.en: And then lately they've been seeing something really horrible, which is a kind of new front in this crisis, which is starvation.
sentences.zh: 最近他们还看到了非常可怕的现象，这是这场危机中的一个新战线，也就是饥饿。

sentences.en: And finding manatees with sand in their stomachs because they're just desperately rooting around trying to find any bits that they can eat.
sentences.zh: 他们发现海牛胃里有沙子，因为它们在绝望地四处翻找，试图找到任何能吃的东西。

sentences.en: Because the water quality has become so bad that these huge seagrass meadows, where manatees have been feeding for hundreds and thousands of years, are dying off.
sentences.zh: 因为水质变得如此糟糕，海牛们已经繁衍生息了成百上千年的巨大海草草甸正在消亡。

sentences.en: And so they go there to eat, and it's just fields of sand.
sentences.zh: 所以它们去那里觅食，结果只有一片片沙地。

sentences.en: Should we get out on the boat?
sentences.zh: 我们应该上船了吗？

sentences.en: You've got to watch the...
sentences.zh: 你得看……

sentences.en: Oh, we have to watch Manatee Manors?
sentences.zh: 哦，我们得看《海牛庄园》吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Welcome to the Crystal River National Wildlife Refuge and the Kings Bay Manatee Refuge.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到水晶河国家野生动物保护区和金斯贝海牛保护区。

sentences.en: I kept asking these experts, like, how do you deal with this emotionally?
sentences.zh: 我一直问这些专家，你们在情感上是怎么应对的？

sentences.en: Is it hard?
sentences.zh: 这很难吗？

sentences.en: Do you cry?
sentences.zh: 你们会哭吗？

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: The following activities, or the attempt to perform any of the following activities, is prohibited throughout Kings Bay.
sentences.zh: 在整个金斯贝禁止进行以下活动，或企图进行以下任何活动。

sentences.en: Chasing or pursuing a manatee...
sentences.zh: 追逐或驱赶海牛……

sentences.en: A lot of them were able to have a kind of scientific detachment.
sentences.zh: 他们中的很多人都能够保持一种科学的超然态度。

sentences.en: They're just really trying to diagnose what's wrong and help as best they can.
sentences.zh: 他们只是努力诊断问题出在哪里，并尽力提供帮助。

sentences.en: But I remember one guy I spoke with, he surprised me a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但我记得和我交谈过的一个人，他稍微让我有点惊讶。

sentences.en: I said, you know, do you have hope for the future of manatees?
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道的，你对海牛的未来抱有希望吗？

sentences.en: Poking, frotting, or stabbing a manatee with anything, including your hands and feet.
sentences.zh: 用任何东西（包括你的手和脚）戳、擦或刺海牛。

sentences.en: And he said, deep in my heart, no.
sentences.zh: 他说，从心底里讲，没有。

sentences.en: Standing or stepping on a manatee?
sentences.zh: 站在海牛身上或踩在海牛身上？

sentences.en: Come on now.
sentences.zh: 拜托。

sentences.en: But he said he's still...
sentences.zh: 但他还是说……

sentences.en: Deep in his heart, no, but he still hopes.
sentences.zh: 从心底里讲，没有，但他依然抱有希望。

sentences.en: Separating a mother and cat...
sentences.zh: 把母亲和幼崽分开……

sentences.en: Or separating a manatee...
sentences.zh: 或者把海牛分开……

sentences.en: He also said, if we can't save manatees, we can't save anything.
sentences.zh: 他还说，如果我们救不了海牛，我们就什么也救不了。

sentences.en: Because manatees are so resilient.
sentences.zh: 因为海牛的生命力极其顽强。

sentences.en: They have really tough skin that's hard to cut.
sentences.zh: 它们有着很难割破的坚韧皮肤。

sentences.en: They have very fast coagulation in their blood, so their wounds heal very quickly, which is how they're able to survive so many of these boat strikes.
sentences.zh: 它们的血液凝固速度非常快，所以伤口愈合得极快，这也是它们能够在如此多的船只撞击中存活下来的原因。

sentences.en: And so if we can't find a way to keep manatees alive, then we're not going to be able to save anything.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们找不到办法让海牛活下去，那我们将无法拯救任何东西。

sentences.en: Let's do it.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: I'm ready.
sentences.zh: 我已经准备好了。

sentences.en: To be honest, that kind of makes me hate us for wanting to swim with manatees.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这让我们想去跟海牛一起游泳的心情都有点变味了。

sentences.en: Well, the people that don't follow the regulations...
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些不遵守规章制度的人……

sentences.en: Even us in our stupid wetsuits floating around in the crowds of people staring at the manatee...
sentences.zh: 甚至连我们穿着愚蠢的潜水服，漂浮在盯着海牛的人群中……

sentences.en: Just, like, shut the whole thing down.
sentences.zh: 就感觉，干脆把整个活动都关停算了。

sentences.en: Hopefully people, you know, will feel a sense of awe and want to protect them.
sentences.zh: 希望大家，你知道的，能怀有一种敬畏之心，并且想要保护它们。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I guess that's, like, the risk-benefit ratio you have to weigh.
sentences.zh: 我想这就像是你必须权衡的风险收益比。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Like, how much does this increase people's awareness and affection, and therefore lead to protection?
sentences.zh: 比如，这能在多大程度上提高人们的意识和喜爱，从而带来保护作用？

sentences.en: And all that, how much does it bother the manatees and mess up the environment?
sentences.zh: 与此相对，它又在多大程度上打扰了海牛、搞砸了环境？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: That's why there had to be, I mean, also a lot of regulation on the tour guides, too.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么必须，我是说，对导游也有很多规章限制的原因。

sentences.en: So, after we signed all of our forms and squeezed into our wetsuits and watched this video, we stepped outside and the sky had cleared miraculously,
sentences.zh: 所以，在我们签完所有表格、挤进潜水服并看完这段视频后，我们走到户外，天空奇迹般地放晴了，

sentences.en: and we got ready to step on this boat.
sentences.zh: 我们准备踏上这艘船。

sentences.en: where Buddy was going to drive us around and hopefully make my stupid manatee dream come true.
sentences.zh: 巴迪将在那儿开车载着我们四处转转，希望把我那愚蠢的海牛梦变成现实。

sentences.en: Why don't we go over to the boat and then we're going to get after you.
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不上船去，然后我们再来找你。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏“纵横连线”，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂”和“连字框”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Have you done one of these before, sir?
sentences.zh: 先生，你以前做过这个吗？

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 我做过。

sentences.en: Okay, so you understand that stream of water that needs to come out of the side of that motor at all times.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以你明白那股必须随时从那个马达侧面喷出的水流是干什么用的。

sentences.en: So, Buddy Powell, the local guide.
sentences.zh: 那么，当地向导巴迪·鲍威尔。

sentences.en: If you're ready to go, I'll get you unhooked.
sentences.zh: 如果你准备好了，我就帮你解开绳索。

sentences.en: All right, thanks a lot.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Gets us in our boat, and we tootle off into the water.
sentences.zh: 带我们上了船，然后我们突突地开进了水里。

sentences.en: This is where you grew up.
sentences.zh: 这就是你长大的地方。

sentences.en: This is where I grew up.
sentences.zh: 这就是我长大的地方。

sentences.en: I was actually born in Clearwater, but my family had like a little fishing cottage up here.
sentences.zh: 我其实出生在清水镇，但我的家人在这里有一个小小的钓鱼小屋。

sentences.en: And I wanted to know all about his Jacques Cousteau experience and what that was like.
sentences.zh: 我想了解他所有关于雅克·库斯托的经历以及那是怎样的感受。

sentences.en: Were you aware of Jacques Cousteau at this point in your life?
sentences.zh: 在你人生的这个阶段，你知道雅克·库斯托吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，知道，知道。

sentences.en: I mean, back in the day when we only had three channels, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在过去我们只有三个电视频道的年代，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, you would sort of wait, you know, whether they come out like four times a year or twice a year.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你得等着，看他们是一年出四次还是两次节目。

sentences.en: It was like a big deal to watch that show.
sentences.zh: 看那个节目可是一件大事。

sentences.en: So, obviously, you know, very much a role model.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，你知道的，他非常像一个榜样。

sentences.en: To be a kid who loved nothing more than being in a boat, who had memorized all the creatures that lived in this habitat that he grew up in,
sentences.zh: 对于一个最喜欢待在船上、把长大的这个栖息地里所有生物都记熟了的孩子来说，

sentences.en: to get a call from Jacques Cousteau in the 1970s, when that name was as big as a name could be.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代接到雅克·库斯托的电话，当时这个名字可以说是如日中天。

sentences.en: Especially for a kid like that.
sentences.zh: 特别是对这样一个孩子来说。

sentences.en: And so they kind of adopted me and took me under their ring.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有点像收养了我，对我悉心照料。

sentences.en: And you must have felt like a little rock star.
sentences.zh: 你当时一定觉得自己像个小摇滚明星。

sentences.en: It was pretty incredible.
sentences.zh: 那真是相当不可思议。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: Did you wear the little red hat?
sentences.zh: 你戴那顶小红帽了吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我戴了。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I did indeed.
sentences.zh: 我确实戴了。

sentences.en: Did you ever try smoking a pipe?
sentences.zh: 你抽过烟斗吗？

sentences.en: I never tried smoking a pipe, no.
sentences.zh: 我从来没抽过烟斗，没有。

sentences.en: Did you drink some wonderful French wine?
sentences.zh: 你喝过什么美妙的法国葡萄酒吗？

sentences.en: I have definitely at that age.
sentences.zh: 我在那个年纪绝对喝过。

sentences.en: They were trying to cultivate my inner Frenchness.
sentences.zh: 他们试图培养我内在的法国风情。

sentences.en: And yes, I drank my fair share of wine.
sentences.zh: 是的，我喝了不少属于我的那份葡萄酒。

sentences.en: And it was a wonderful experience.
sentences.zh: 那是一段美妙的经历。

sentences.en: Because I, it's just absolutely fabulous.
sentences.zh: 因为我，这简直太棒了。

sentences.en: And of course, that just changed my entire life.
sentences.zh: 当然，那彻底改变了我的一生。

sentences.en: So, I'm going to be keeping an eye out, you know, as we're going along for manatees.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，在我们前行的时候，我会一直留意海牛。

sentences.en: But, um, I wanted to tell you a little bit of, about what we're seeing here.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，我想跟你多聊聊我们在这里看到的东西。

sentences.en: So, this, this whole Crystal River.
sentences.zh: 所以，这，整个水晶河。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, he's steering us all over his childhood territory.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他正驾着船带我们游览他童年时期的领地。

sentences.en: And he's, of course, able to say, you know, this used to be like this.
sentences.zh: 当然，他能够说，你看，这里以前是这样的。

sentences.en: And this used to be like that.
sentences.zh: 这里以前是那样的。

sentences.en: And now there's a giant mansion here.
sentences.zh: 现在这里有一座巨大的豪宅。

sentences.en: And now, he said the water used to be, I mean, it's called Crystal River because the water used to be crystal clear.
sentences.zh: 现在，他说这水以前，我的意思是，它叫水晶河，因为这水以前清澈见底。

sentences.en: And now it's pretty murky in most of it.
sentences.zh: 而现在大部分地方都相当浑浊。

sentences.en: The water quality has really plummeted.
sentences.zh: 水质确实大大下降了。

sentences.en: And you used to see none of the, of the boat traffic that we were seeing that day.
sentences.zh: 你以前根本见不到那天我们看到的那些船只交通。

sentences.en: You would not see groups of tourists out there looking for manatees.
sentences.zh: 你不会看到成群的游客在那里寻找海牛。

sentences.en: It was just, it was just Buddy and the manatees all alone back in those days.
sentences.zh: 在那些日子里，只有巴迪和海牛孤单相伴。

sentences.en: What are these little heads that I keep seeing popping out of the water?
sentences.zh: 我一直看到从水里冒出来的这些小脑袋是什么？

sentences.en: Those are turtles.
sentences.zh: 那是海龟。

sentences.en: He's, you know, I keep seeing things in the water.
sentences.zh: 他，你知道的，我一直在水里看到东西。

sentences.en: I see like a little, something pop up from the water.
sentences.zh: 我看到好像有个小东西从水里冒出来。

sentences.en: And I'm like, manatee.
sentences.zh: 我就想，是海牛。

sentences.en: But he's like, nope, that's a turtle.
sentences.zh: 但他却说，不，那是海龟。

sentences.en: And something would jump out of the water and just be a fish.
sentences.zh: 有时候有什么东西会跳出水面，结果只是一条鱼。

sentences.en: But then at one point he did say, there it is.
sentences.zh: 但后来有一次他确实说，看那儿。

sentences.en: Or 11 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 在11点钟方向。

sentences.en: So you can see the series of them.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到它们排成一串。

sentences.en: And one in front of the other.
sentences.zh: 一个接在另一个后面。

sentences.en: So it's just slowly swimming along.
sentences.zh: 它们就这样缓缓地游着。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we saw this manatee off to the left of the boat.
sentences.zh: 我们看到这只海牛在船的左侧。

sentences.en: So we don't want to disturb it because it's there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不想打扰它，因为它就在那儿。

sentences.en: It's coming up the surface.
sentences.zh: 它正浮出水面。

sentences.en: See the back?
sentences.zh: 看到背部了吗？

sentences.en: There's the back of it.
sentences.zh: 那是它的背部。

sentences.en: So that's a nice and dull manatee.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一只挺温顺的海牛。

sentences.en: The tail, we saw the whole.
sentences.zh: 尾巴，我们看到了整个。

sentences.en: See its back come up and then its tail.
sentences.zh: 看它的背部浮起来，然后是尾巴。

sentences.en: And it would leave these, what Buddy called tail prints on the water.
sentences.zh: 它会在水面上留下巴迪所说的尾迹。

sentences.en: That's so you could sort of follow where it was going.
sentences.zh: 这样你就可以顺着追踪它去的地方。

sentences.en: And it was really thrilling to see one so far from shore just doing its natural thing.
sentences.zh: 能看到一只海牛远离海岸做着它自然的事情，真的非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Does it still feel special for you to see a manatee?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，看到海牛仍然觉得很特别吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: It's hard to explain it.
sentences.zh: 这很难解释。

sentences.en: But every time I see a manatee, I still get excited about it.
sentences.zh: 但每次看到海牛，我仍然会感到兴奋。

sentences.en: So we're cruising around.
sentences.zh: 所以我们四处巡游。

sentences.en: He's taking us down little side coves.
sentences.zh: 他带我们驶入小小的侧湾。

sentences.en: And as we're cruising around, we keep seeing these other tourist boats and crowds of people in the water.
sentences.zh: 在我们巡游时，我们不断看到其他旅游船只和水中的大批人群。

sentences.en: And that was the fastest way to find a manatee.
sentences.zh: 那是找到海牛最快的方法。

sentences.en: It's kind of like when you're at Yellowstone.
sentences.zh: 这有点像你在黄石公园的时候。

sentences.en: The fastest way to find a bear is to find the traffic jam of people looking at the bear on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 找到熊最快的方法就是找到路边看熊的人流拥堵处。

sentences.en: Here, there were traffic jams of boats and crowds of tourists who were floating with pool noodles and, you know, flippers and goggles.
sentences.zh: 在这里，有船只造成的交通拥堵，还有成群结队的游客，他们带着浮棒，还有，你知道的，蛙鞋和护目镜。

sentences.en: And they're all just kind of hanging around a manatee while it's eating.
sentences.zh: 他们都只是围着一头正在吃东西的海牛晃悠。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I feel almost inclined not to get in the water with a big crowd of people staring at one manatee.
sentences.zh: 我几乎不想下水去面对一大群人盯着一只海牛的场面。

sentences.en: Yeah, I can understand.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我能理解。

sentences.en: So we're kind of keeping our distance because once I see that, it's not what I imagined for my manatee encounter.
sentences.zh: 所以我们保持着一定的距离，因为一旦我看到那个，这与我想象中的海牛奇遇完全不同。

sentences.en: Somehow it does not feel to me like outside of the predator-prey hustle-and-bustle chain, the sort of...
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，这给我感觉不像是在捕食者与猎物那种喧嚣的链条之外，那种……

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: There's two propeller marks on it.
sentences.zh: 上面有两个螺旋桨印记。

sentences.en: Two propeller marks.
sentences.zh: 两个螺旋桨印记。

sentences.en: Can you tell what size that one was?
sentences.zh: 你能看出那是多大的一只吗？

sentences.en: It's a small adult.
sentences.zh: 是一只小成年海牛。

sentences.en: He's hanging out at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 它在水底闲逛。

sentences.en: Can you describe what the scene looks like?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下这里的场景是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: Uh, well, we got one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight...
sentences.zh: 呃，好吧，我们数数，一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八……

sentences.en: Plus boats out here full of people in wetsuits.
sentences.zh: 外面还有满载着穿着潜水服的人的船只。

sentences.en: And then we've got groups of people in wetsuits with pool noodles and snorkels sticking up who are in the water, kind of face down.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到一群群穿着潜水服的人，带着浮棒和朝上的浮潜管，面朝下泡在水里。

sentences.en: All in a tight cluster, we assume, staring at one manatee.
sentences.zh: 我们猜想，他们都紧紧聚集成团，盯着一只海牛。

sentences.en: We've got two or three groups of people like that.
sentences.zh: 我们有两三拨这样的人群。

sentences.en: Um, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: We've got boats docked outside of houses.
sentences.zh: 房子外面停着船。

sentences.en: Boats with huge, huge, powerful-looking motors.
sentences.zh: 那些船装着巨大无比、看起来动力十足的马达。

sentences.en: This boat has two giant motors on the back, two big Honda motors.
sentences.zh: 这艘船后面有两个巨大的马达，两个大本田马达。

sentences.en: And as you can see, he doesn't realize that there's a manatee.
sentences.zh: 正如你所看到的，他没有意识到有一头海牛。

sentences.en: As you can see, you can see the bottom.
sentences.zh: 正如你所见，你能看到水底。

sentences.en: It's not really that shallow.
sentences.zh: 其实并不是那么浅。

sentences.en: Doing some damage.
sentences.zh: 正在造成一些破坏。

sentences.en: Well, he's going slowly enough that that manatee will, you know, will move out of the way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他开得够慢，所以那头海牛会，你知道的，会避开的。

sentences.en: But, um, if he wasn't going slowly, yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，如果他不开慢点，是的，绝对会出事。

sentences.en: And not only that, it's just a matter of disturbance, too.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，这也是一个干扰的问题。

sentences.en: These, you know, these animals, they become somewhat habituated, but generally, they just, you know, they want to be left alone to, you know, to feed.
sentences.zh: 这些，你知道的，这些动物，它们变得有点习惯了，但总的来说，它们只是，你知道的，希望被留着清净，好去，你知道的，觅食。

sentences.en: So, we basically did this all day.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们基本上整天都在这样做。

sentences.en: We'd see a manatee, it would be surrounded by a crowd, and I would say, well, let's try another one.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一头海牛，它被人群包围着，然后我会说，好吧，我们去看看别的吧。

sentences.en: And finally, the day was over.
sentences.zh: 最后，一天结束了。

sentences.en: I was sunburned.
sentences.zh: 我晒伤了。

sentences.en: We had to take the boat back.
sentences.zh: 我们得把船开回去。

sentences.en: And we went into this little lagoon.
sentences.zh: 我们开进了一个小海湾。

sentences.en: And there was a manatee, and there was a crowd of people around it.
sentences.zh: 这里有一只海牛，周围围了一群人。

sentences.en: I don't know, Kelsey, how do you feel?
sentences.zh: 我不知道，凯尔西，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Do you want to jump in?
sentences.zh: 你想跳下去吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm hot, so...
sentences.zh: 我是说，我很热，所以……

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, me too.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，我也是。

sentences.en: And I thought about it and decided, okay.
sentences.zh: 我想了想，决定好吧。

sentences.en: I guess we should probably just do it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大概应该直接下去。

sentences.en: See, we could do it here.
sentences.zh: 你看，我们可以在这儿下。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Since we know we're here.
sentences.zh: 既然我们都知道我们在这儿了。

sentences.en: Came all this way.
sentences.zh: 大老远来了。

sentences.en: I don't want to miss my opportunity and regret it later.
sentences.zh: 我不想错过机会以后后悔。

sentences.en: So, I guess I'll just be one of the crowd and get in there.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想我就随大流下去吧。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Let's try it.
sentences.zh: 我们试试吧。

sentences.en: These guys are kind of harassing it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 这几个人有点在骚扰它。

sentences.en: And sometimes Buddy would point out, like, oh, they're kind of harassing that manatee.
sentences.zh: 有时巴迪会指出，哦，他们有点在骚扰那只海牛。

sentences.en: You're really not supposed to be that close, or you're not supposed to be swimming after it.
sentences.zh: 你们真不该靠得这么近，或者说不该追着它游。

sentences.en: You just stay still and let it do what it wants, and you don't follow it, and you don't interact.
sentences.zh: 你只要静静待着，让它随心所欲，不要跟着它，也不要互动。

sentences.en: You just look.
sentences.zh: 你只要看着就行。

sentences.en: He told me to just float like a log when I get in there.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我在下去的时候像根木头一样漂着就行。

sentences.en: And just try to stay at least a manatee or two lengths away from it.
sentences.zh: 尽量和它保持至少一两只海牛身位的距离。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What if it approaches?
sentences.zh: 如果它靠近怎么办？

sentences.en: Then you just stay still and let it do its thing.
sentences.zh: 那你就保持不动，让它自个儿玩去。

sentences.en: So, Sam, I'm probably going to stay up here.
sentences.zh: 所以，萨姆，我可能留在上面。

sentences.en: Maybe you can see what you're doing as you're doing it, as you're getting in the water.
sentences.zh: 也许你下水的时候可以看着自己在做什么。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to put this snorkel on and take my shoes off.
sentences.zh: 那我要戴上呼吸管，脱掉鞋子了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, there's two right here just feeding.
sentences.zh: 这里正有两只在吃东西。

sentences.en: And so, what you don't want to do is disturb them in any way.
sentences.zh: 所以，你千万不要以任何方式打扰它们。

sentences.en: And just be as quiet as you possibly can.
sentences.zh: 尽量保持绝对安静。

sentences.en: Keep an eye on me.
sentences.zh: 帮我看着点。

sentences.en: Because I can, obviously, the only reason I don't get in the water is I can spot and see further away.
sentences.zh: 因为我，显然，我不下水的唯一原因是我能站在高处看得更远。

sentences.en: And so, I'll sort of give you directions.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会给你指方向。

sentences.en: I don't like to yell out over the water.
sentences.zh: 我不想在水面上大喊大叫。

sentences.en: But just, occasionally, just lift your head up and take a look at me.
sentences.zh: 不过偶尔把头抬起来看我一眼就行。

sentences.en: Keep an eye out for alligators.
sentences.zh: 注意防范短吻鳄。

sentences.en: I'll tell you if one comes.
sentences.zh: 如果有鳄鱼来我告诉你的。

sentences.en: The sun came out for us.
sentences.zh: 太阳为我们出来了。

sentences.en: Appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 谢了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Still over there.
sentences.zh: 还在那边。

sentences.en: Because there's two over here.
sentences.zh: 因为这边有两只。

sentences.en: So, I, you know, I was in my wetsuit already.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我当时已经穿好了防寒衣。

sentences.en: I put on my flippers and my goggles and my snorkel and got in the water.
sentences.zh: 我戴上脚蹼、泳镜和呼吸管下了水。

sentences.en: So, 72 degrees doesn't feel that warm.
sentences.zh: 所以，72华氏度感觉其实没那么暖和。

sentences.en: Kind of chilly water.
sentences.zh: 水有点凉。

sentences.en: So, I get in and the water is very murky.
sentences.zh: 我下了水，水非常浑浊。

sentences.en: There's a lot.
sentences.zh: 有很多。

sentences.en: 11 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 11点钟方向。

sentences.en: Straight ahead.
sentences.zh: 正前方。

sentences.en: 12 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 12点钟方向。

sentences.en: 11 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 11点钟方向。

sentences.en: There's a lot of plants.
sentences.zh: 有很多植物。

sentences.en: A lot of seagrass.
sentences.zh: 有很多海草。

sentences.en: And so, it's just like murk and seagrass.
sentences.zh: 到处都是浑浊的水和海草。

sentences.en: And I can't really see where I'm going.
sentences.zh: 我根本看不清我去哪儿了。

sentences.en: But I know the general direction the manatee is in.
sentences.zh: 但我知道海牛所在的大致方向。

sentences.en: And Buddy is kind of shouting out, you know, it's at 11 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 巴迪在一边大喊，你知道的，在11点钟方向。

sentences.en: And he's guiding me across the water.
sentences.zh: 他在水面上引导我。

sentences.en: So, I'm kind of just swimming with a face full of murky seagrass.
sentences.zh: 所以我满脸都是浑浊的海草往前游。

sentences.en: And I can't see where I'm going.
sentences.zh: 我看不见前方的路。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure if I'm going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我也不确定自己有没有在前进。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, it was such a shock.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，太震撼了。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, I come shooting out of the murk.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我从浑浊的水中冲了出来。

sentences.en: And I'm just, I'm like on top of the manatee, practically.
sentences.zh: 我几乎就骑在海牛身上了。

sentences.en: I did not see it coming.
sentences.zh: 我根本没看到它过来。

sentences.en: By the time I saw it, I was there.
sentences.zh: 等我看到它时，我已经到了。

sentences.en: And it's eating, facing away from me.
sentences.zh: 它在吃东西，背对我。

sentences.en: And so, I come to a stop basically right next to its gigantic tail, which I know from my manatee research is so strong and potentially dangerous.
sentences.zh: 所以我停下来的地方基本上紧挨着它巨大的尾巴，根据我对海牛的研究，我知道这尾巴力大无穷且极具危险性。

sentences.en: And so, I was instantly kind of panicked.
sentences.zh: 所以我瞬间有点恐慌。

sentences.en: But I also knew that rule number one of being near a manatee is that you can't panic and thrash around because you'll scare the manatee and then it will potentially thrash.
sentences.zh: 但我也知道靠近海牛的第一条规则是你不能恐慌和乱扑腾，因为那样会吓到海牛，它可能也会乱扑腾。

sentences.en: And so, I had to sort of work as hard as I could to stop my momentum as quickly but as gently as I could until my momentum stopped just like inches from the manatee tail.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须尽我所能，以最快但最温柔的方式卸掉我的冲劲，直到我在离海牛尾巴仅几英寸的地方停下来。

sentences.en: And I was able to kind of scooch backwards very slowly until I was a few feet away.
sentences.zh: 我得以非常缓慢地往后挪，直到离它几英尺远。

sentences.en: And then I just watched, I just stared because this thing was so otherworldly, almost like
sentences.zh: 然后我就看着，直勾勾地看着，因为这东西太超现实了，简直像是

sentences.en: ghostly, pale, kind of gray color, almost like glowing in the light.
sentences.zh: 幽灵般苍白灰暗的颜色，在光线中几乎像是在发光。

sentences.en: And it's just peacefully eating grass.
sentences.zh: 它就那样平静地吃着海草。

sentences.en: And all these other people are around me but we're not noticing each other at all because we're all just so in awe of this manatee really.
sentences.zh: 周围有这么多人，但我们谁也没注意到彼此，因为我们都被这只海牛深深震撼了。

sentences.en: And I don't know how long I floated there, but for a pretty long time.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我在那儿漂了多久，反正挺长时间的。

sentences.en: And then I decided, all right, I saw a manatee.
sentences.zh: 然后我决定，好吧，我看到海牛了。

sentences.en: Didn't turn around and look at me, which, I mean, why would it?
sentences.zh: 它没有转过身来看我，也是，它凭什么看我呢？

sentences.en: But that was okay.
sentences.zh: 不过没关系。

sentences.en: So, very gently I turned and I swam through the murk back to the boat.
sentences.zh: 于是我非常温柔地转身，穿过浑浊的水游回了船边。

sentences.en: And just as I was starting to tell everybody what I had seen, one of the, one of the little crowd watching the manatee eat shouted, it's turning, it's coming your way.
sentences.zh: 正当我开始跟所有人讲我看到了什么时，围观海牛吃东西的人群中有一个人大喊道：它在转身，它朝你们那边游过来了。

sentences.en: And I turned and the manatee had turned around and was swimming directly toward our boat.
sentences.zh: 我转过身，那只海牛已经转过身，正径直朝我们的船游来。

sentences.en: And so I just gently let go of the ladder and dropped back under the water to see what it was going to do.
sentences.zh: 于是我轻轻松开梯子，重新潜回水下，想看看它要做什么。

sentences.en: And the manatee came right over to me and started grazing the seagrass right next to our boat, kind of down below my flippers.
sentences.zh: 海牛径直游向我，开始在我们的船边啃食海草，就在我脚蹼下方不远处。

sentences.en: And so I just floated there, suspended, watching it.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是悬浮在那里，静静地看着它。

sentences.en: And then after a few seconds, the most magical thing happened, which is the manatee stopped
sentences.zh: 接着几秒钟后，最神奇的事情发生了，那就是海牛停止了

sentences.en: eating and it tilted its body up vertical and it floated up toward the surface and it paused and it looked at me.
sentences.zh: 进食，它的身体竖了起来，向水面浮去，它停顿了一下，看着我。

sentences.en: Like it really looked me in the eyes and I was looking at the manatee and the manatee was looking at me and I always fantasized about this moment and all the many feelings that
sentences.zh: 就像它真的在看着我的眼睛，我看着海牛，海牛看着我，我曾经无数次幻想过这一刻，幻想我们之间会有多少种情绪

sentences.en: would pass between us and we would just kind of beam warm feelings back and forth to each other.
sentences.zh: 流转，我们只是在彼此之间传递着温暖的情感。

sentences.en: I felt in the manatee's gaze, I felt nothing.
sentences.zh: 但在海牛的眼神中，我什么也没感觉到。

sentences.en: There was no magical soul connection.
sentences.zh: 没有什么神奇的心灵感应。

sentences.en: And that was, that was good and normal.
sentences.zh: 这很好，也很正常。

sentences.en: And the fantasy I had was abnormal.
sentences.zh: 我之前的幻想才是不正常的。

sentences.en: And I should probably talk to my therapist, Susan, about it on Friday at 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我大概应该在周五下午1点跟我的治疗师苏珊谈谈这事。

sentences.en: And so it kept drifting up and it took a breath and then it went back down with bubbles coming
sentences.zh: 于是它继续向上漂，换了口气，然后带着一串气泡又沉了下去

sentences.en: out and it tilted itself back to horizontal and it started just swimming past me and under the boat.
sentences.zh: 身体重新恢复水平，开始从我身旁和船底下游过去。

sentences.en: And this thing was so huge.
sentences.zh: 这东西太巨大了。

sentences.en: It took forever.
sentences.zh: 花了好久好久。

sentences.en: It felt like it felt like it was swimming in slow motion.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像在慢动作游泳。

sentences.en: I just watched its whole pale glowing body kind of pass right in front of my face, peacefully gracefully.
sentences.zh: 我看着它苍白发光的整个身体从我眼前平静而优雅地游过。

sentences.en: And its huge tail came by laSt.
sentences.zh: 它巨大的尾巴最后划过。

sentences.en: And then it was gone.
sentences.zh: 然后它就消失了。

sentences.en: And I went back up to the surface.
sentences.zh: 我回到了水面上。

sentences.en: This one here was so close.
sentences.zh: 这里的这一只太近了。

sentences.en: Speeding right there.
sentences.zh: 就在那里飞驰而过。

sentences.en: Came up, surfaced right in front of me to breathe.
sentences.zh: 浮上来，就在我眼前浮出水面呼吸。

sentences.en: Looked at me.
sentences.zh: 看着我。

sentences.en: Which, that was my goal.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我的目标。

sentences.en: I wanted to be looked at by a manatee.
sentences.zh: 我想被海牛看一眼。

sentences.en: Looked deep into your soul?
sentences.zh: 看进你的灵魂深处了吗？

sentences.en: No, she didn't.
sentences.zh: 不，它没有。

sentences.en: And I really was so jazzed.
sentences.zh: 我真的超级兴奋。

sentences.en: I really was.
sentences.zh: 真的非常兴奋。

sentences.en: It was, it was, it was very profound.
sentences.zh: 这感觉太，太，太深刻了。

sentences.en: It just looked at me.
sentences.zh: 它只是看着我。

sentences.en: How are you feeling right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I feel good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很好。

sentences.en: I feel happy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很幸福。

sentences.en: Horrible?
sentences.zh: 糟糕吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel like weirdly fulfilled.
sentences.zh: 对，我有一种不可思议的满足感。

sentences.en: Like a life mission has been fulfilled.
sentences.zh: 就像人生使命达成了一样。

sentences.en: What was it like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It was, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就是，对。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It was sweet.
sentences.zh: 很美好。

sentences.en: The people were sweet.
sentences.zh: 大家都很温柔。

sentences.en: I wonder where that manatee is now.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那只海牛现在在哪里。

sentences.en: I bet it's right near the same spot eating.
sentences.zh: 我敢说它肯定还在原地附近吃东西。

sentences.en: Eating grass.
sentences.zh: 吃草。

sentences.en: Taking a nap.
sentences.zh: 打个盹。

sentences.en: Farting.
sentences.zh: 放个屁。

sentences.en: Sending bubbles up to the surface.
sentences.zh: 往水面冒一串气泡。

sentences.en: Big jowls shaking while it chews.
sentences.zh: 咀嚼时大大的腮帮子一抖一抖的。

sentences.en: It's lettuce.
sentences.zh: 那是生菜。

sentences.en: It's grass.
sentences.zh: 那是草。
